topics.title: 2025 INFL TA Key Milestone Overview – Overall Status (May 14, 2025)

background.text: As of May 14, 2025, all activities in the 2025 INFL TA milestone plan are on track. Key milestones include Nerandomilast IPF NDA submission (Sep 2025), PPF NDA submission, chILD Ph3 1st SIV, CatCi FPFV/FPI/FPFT, Spesolimab PG Ph3 SIV, cGAS Ph2 INF CTA submission, and others. Some items are on-hold or postponed: FIBRONEER-SARD Ph3b 1st SIV (on-hold, TBU); chILD Ph3 HAI meeting request submission (postponed, TBU); NOX-4 inh. Ph2 early ILD CTA submission (on-hold, TBU). Spesolimab NS sNDA submission and BTD & pre-NDA are discontinued.
